status: superseded 2 Nov: the owner chose a transfer to the 64-zero burn address instead of the burn method; see the spec §R2
goal:
Read the exact burn method of mpoo.nearlytrade.near before REV-D builds on it.

SCOPE
- From the deployed contract (ABI/metadata if exposed, else source or a dry-run view of the wasm), record: method name, arguments and their JSON shape, attached deposit required, who may call it (any holder? only for its own balance?), gas, and what event it logs.
- Check whether a contract account (the board) can burn its own balance, and whether the board must be storage-registered first.
- Record the evidence (command and output, or a testnet/mainnet transaction that called it).

ACCEPTANCE
- The spec's R2 section names the signature with evidence. If burn can't be called by the board, stop and tell the owner: R2's 20% needs a different route.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
